en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Fal Al Hashimy, from his father and his uncle who both said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Application of Kohl with antimony (white eye-powder) aromatises the breath and strengthens the edges of the eyes’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Fadl al-Flashimiy from his father and uncle who have said the following: “
Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Applying eye powder with Athmad (antimony) sweetens the fragrance and strengthens the edge of the eyelid.’”
